About Ordinal Numbers

Ordinal numbers from first to thirtieth, the way dates are said. The learner hears "Tap twelfth." and chooses 12th, hears "Tap the twelfth one." and taps 12 from numbers in counting order, or sees one number marked on a grid of 1 to 30 and chooses its word. The wrong options are the ones people mix up: thirteenth and thirtieth, twelfth and twentieth.

How to play

  1. Listen to the number.
  2. Look at the options.
  3. Tap the answer.

Play it as a class

Choose Ordinal Numbers in the Teacher Game, then say the dates of this month's classes aloud.
